integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.lede: Connect your tools so Leadtita can work with your own data.
integrations.description: Attach sheets, docs, CSV or PDF files from your Drive to a message and Leadtita reads them right then.
integrations.loadError: We couldn't check your Google connection.
integrations.notConfigured: Integration not configured. Let us know and we'll turn it on.
integrations.hintFiles: You only share the files you pick. You can disconnect at any time.
integrations.hintFull: Leadtita will be able to search your whole Drive (read-only). You can disconnect at any time.
integrations.pickerNotConfigured: The file picker isn't configured yet.
integrations.pickerError: We couldn't open the Google picker. Try again.
integrations.disconnectBody: Drive, Gmail and Calendar disconnect together: Leadtita stops using them and we revoke access on Google. You can reconnect at any time.
integrations.noticeDenied: You cancelled the Google permission. You can try again any time.
integrations.noticeError: We couldn't finish connecting to Google. Try again.

gmail.title: Gmail
gmail.description: Leadtita sends the emails you confirm from your account.
gmail.hint: Send-only permission: we never read your inbox.

calendar.title: Google Calendar
calendar.description: Leadtita books meetings with your leads on your primary calendar.
calendar.hint: Permission to create and edit events; we don't read the rest of your calendar.

whatsapp.description: Link your WhatsApp and Leadtita sends the messages you confirm.
whatsapp.notConfigured: WhatsApp isn't available yet. Let us know and we'll turn it on.
whatsapp.qrAlt: QR code to link your WhatsApp with Leadta
whatsapp.risk: Unofficial connection: WhatsApp may restrict numbers that send many messages to people who don't have them saved. Leadtita spaces out messages and caps them at 100 per month.

errors.worker: The WhatsApp service isn't responding. Try again shortly.
errors.connect: We couldn't start linking. Try again.

whatsapp.disconnectBody: Leadtita stops sending through WhatsApp and queued messages are cancelled. To use it again you'll need to scan a new code.

setup.title: Connect your channels
setup.lede: Leadtita sends the messages you confirm through WhatsApp and Gmail. Connect them now and you're all set.

integrations.attachFromChat: Drive files are attached to a single message from the Leadtita chat (+ → Google Drive). They aren't stored on your account.

apps.title: Connected apps
apps.description: Use leadta from Claude or ChatGPT with your account. Available on paid plans.
apps.loadError: We couldn't load your connected apps.
apps.disconnectBody: {client} loses access to your account right away. To use it again you'll need to reconnect it.
apps.disconnectError: We couldn't disconnect. Please try again.
apps.empty: You haven't connected any apps yet.
apps.copyError: We couldn't copy it. Select the URL and copy it manually.
apps.claude: In claude.ai: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. Paste the URL and accept the permissions.
apps.chatgpt: In ChatGPT: Settings → Connectors (with developer mode on) → add an MCP server with the URL.
